authorization_rule: All required gates must pass with current evidence and artifact hashes; physical motion must still be explicitly confirmed at run time.

camera_orientation.evidence: Run validation_manager.py confirm-camera-orientation after viewing the live flip-method=2 CSI feed.

motor_mapping_software.evidence: Run validation_manager.py record-self-test to execute and record the hardware-free integration self-test.

yolo_current_regression.evidence: Historical real-CSI result exists; rerun yolo_csi_benchmark.py for current-build evidence.

ipm_physical_calibration.evidence: Run calibrate_ipm.py with the independent four-corner ground target, then record-ipm-calibration.

ipm_live_dry_run.evidence: Remove or fully mask the inner circle, then run ipm_live_dry_run.py on the centred outer-circle single line after physical IPM calibration.

outer_circle_positions.evidence: After ipm_live_dry_run passes, run outer_circle_position_validation.py at STRAIGHT, CURVE_ENTRY, CURVE_APEX and CURVE_EXIT with the motor battery disconnected.

integrated_control_dry_run.evidence: Run integrated_control_dry_run.py only after the four outer-circle representative positions pass; exercise DRIVE, obstacle STOP and missing-line STOP.

raised_motor_adapter.evidence: Run motor_adapter_raised_test.py with both wheels raised.

short_floor_steering.evidence: Run steering_floor_validation.py only after the raised adapter gate passes; verify brief left and right corrections on a guarded floor lane.
